exemptGlobalVariables.name: LASTEXITCODE
exemptGlobalVariables.reason: Any native command overwrites $global:LASTEXITCODE, and a reader of it after a fake native call receives the fake's own value; restoring it in every writer would change no behavior (issue #1096, Decision 2).

entries.name: [string]$key
entries.reason: Class C2: the write is the restore itself; it sits in the $script:restoreEnvironment scriptblock, which the AfterEach block of the same file invokes through a scriptblock variable, a route the scan's pairing rules do not follow.
